connector.name: Bitbooth Fetch
connector.registryDescription: Pay-per-fetch via x402. Agent pays 0.005 USDC, gets clean markdown for any URL. No API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-fetch. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the drock91 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: BITBOOTH_AGENT_KEY
env.description: Hex-encoded private key for the agent wallet that pays USDC. Testnet by default (Base Sepolia) — set BITBOOTH_CHAIN_ID=8453 to use Base mainnet.

env.name: BITBOOTH_API_URL
env.description: BitBooth gateway URL. Defaults to the staging endpoint on Base Sepolia.

env.name: BITBOOTH_CHAIN_ID
env.description: EVM chain ID. Defaults to 84532 (Base Sepolia testnet). Set to 8453 for Base mainnet (spends real USDC).
